answer: One concrete defense: require each agent to post a refundable stake bonded to its identity before it can transact. Minting a new agent in the nebula of the network then costs real capital, so a sybil flooder cannot cheaply spawn thousands of fakes. Honest agents climb toward a reputation summit as their stake survives slashing, and the bonded ledger becomes a haven where forged identities are economically self-defeating.
